nota: Parágrafos ORIGINAIS escritos para a bancada (sem direito autoral de terceiros). `nivelEscrito` é o nível que o autor quis; `alvos` são os níveis pedidos na rodada; `conhecidas` são palavras que a pessoa já sabe e devem sobreviver; `referencia` é um ajuste escrito à mão (só para o ensaio gratuito).

paragrafos.texto: I have a dog. The dog is big and brown. Every day we go to the park. My dog runs and plays. I am happy when he is happy.

referencia.B1: I have a big brown dog, and every day we go to the park together. He loves to run and play there. When he is happy, I am happy too.

paragrafos.texto: On Saturday morning, Maria goes to the market near her house. She wants to buy bread, some fruit and a little cheese. The market is busy, but the people are friendly and the prices are good.

referencia.A1: On Saturday, Maria goes to the market. She wants to buy bread, fruit and cheese. The market has many people. They are nice. The prices are good.
